notes.title: STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. joins the Anime Game Fest 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello Players,
[/p][p]The text-based role-playing game inspired by PC-98 era Japanese text adventures STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. is now holding an open Playtest on Steam!
[/p][p]STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. is a text-based role-playing galgame inspired by the nostalgic PC-98 Japanese text adventures. You are an enforcer of the interstellar trading giant EN Corporation. Together with your partner, the "Combat-Ready Specialized Proxy" Akimi, you travel to distant and remote star sectors to investigate a mysterious planetary blackout event. However, due to a jump accident, your arrival is delayed 19,280 times.
[/p][p]In this chaotic and dangerous dystopian cyberpunk world, you will face various dangerous situations. The game features not only the main storyline, but also side quests, and a significant number of random encounters and exploration scenarios. Similar to traditional tabletop role-playing games, players must overcome challenges through dice rolls and their characters' skills. Your luck and decisions will change the plot and the fate of your characters.
[/p][p]Head over to the Steam store page now and click \[Join the Playtest] to begin your dystopian cyberpunk journey through the stars. Every bit of feedback and gameplay experience you share will be invaluable for Áine and Akimi’s adventure!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666160/_AAA/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Version Now Available In Gcores Game Page
notes.content:
[p]G-Fusion Game Festival 2025 Beijing is live this weekend![/p][p]
STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. is showcasing its latest version at the event—come try it out at booth B02 (Whisper Games) or B09 (GCORES Publishing) and chat directly with the developer! We value your feedback deeply.[/p][p][/p][p]For those unable to attend in person, we've also prepared a special online Playtest version with a rich content offering. While the Steam Playtest is still pending approval, we didn’t want to keep you waiting—head over to the [url="https://www.gcores.com/games/105340"]GCORES game page[/url] to download the same version being showcased at the event![/p][p][/p][p]We'll release the official Playtest version on Steam as soon as it’s approved, and notify everyone right away.[/p][p]
Thank you again for your passionate support![/p][p][/p][p]-Lots of Love from Aine & Akimi[/p]

notes.title: STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. Joins the Visual Novel Fest
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [i]STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A.[/i] will be participating in the Visual Novel Festival! We look forward to meeting you there!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666160/_AAA/][i]STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A.[/i][/url] is a text-based role-playing galgame inspired by the nostalgic PC-98 Japanese text adventures. You are an enforcer of the interstellar trading giant EN Corporation. Together with your partner, the "Combat-Ready Specialized Proxy" Akimi, you travel to distant and remote star sectors to investigate a mysterious planetary blackout event. However, due to a jump accident, your arrival is delayed 19,280 times.

In this chaotic and dangerous dystopian cyberpunk world, you will face various dangerous situations. The game features not only the main storyline but also side quests and a significant number of random encounters and exploration scenarios. Similar to traditional tabletop role-playing games, players must overcome challenges through dice rolls and their characters' skills. Your luck and decisions will change the plot and the fate of your characters.

Thank you for your patience, dear players! [i]STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A.[/i] is currently in full development. There are also many excellent titles featured in the event—wishing you all a great time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747782/91427eff5e90a0c306bd3b43b13d3581d1ab2f47.png[/img]

notes.title: STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. will exhibit at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2024
notes.content:
The visual novel RPG STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A., developed by Inkfield Studio, has officially announced a co-publishing partnership with GCORES PUBLISHING and WhisperGames, bringing even more support to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747782/44c51ca805cdf977e12756dd2a1e16f05d36a953.jpg[/img]

At last week's Jingcai Jingfang (G-Fusion 2024 Beijing), the developer of STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. showcased the latest playable demo at the GCORES PUBLISHING booth, where it received enthusiastic feedback from players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747782/321f5e14130be0a8dbbd94f7446524829a9ca70c.jpg[/img]

In addition, STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. has been confirmed to appear at the 2024 Tokyo Game Show (TGS). From September 26 to 29, visitors can experience the latest playable demo at WhisperGames' booth (09-C36, Hall 9).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747782/bc8056efecf36071f82cfab4cf3c59454a05949e.jpg[/img]

Moreover, attendees at TGS will be able to interact with cosplayers portraying the in-game character Ánie Aflington, adding an extra layer of excitement to the event. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747782/30fe9a13456e01bcde5ba919b79ce4a355a21475.jpg[/img]
